name: real-water-workspace
description: Real Water — a native Three.js WebGPU open-water runtime, its Reference Experience, and the workspace that verifies both.

scripts.api:check: tsc -b packages/real-water && api-extractor run --config packages/real-water/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --config packages/real-water/api-extractor.diagnostics.json
scripts.api:report: tsc -b packages/real-water && api-extractor run --local --config packages/real-water/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local --config packages/real-water/api-extractor.diagnostics.json
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build apps/reference-experience && node scripts/check-reference-production.mjs
scripts.verify: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check . && tsc -b --pretty false && vite build apps/reference-experience && node scripts/check-reference-production.mjs && vitest run && playwright test && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs && api-extractor run --config packages/real-water/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --config packages/real-water/api-extractor.diagnostics.json && node scripts/check-license-inventory.mjs && node scripts/check-core-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/derive-quality-profile-hashes.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -b && vite build apps/reference-experience && node scripts/check-reference-production.mjs && vitest run && playwright test
scripts.test:package: tsc -b && vite build apps/reference-experience && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs

author: Real Water contributors
